fact: The National Communications Authority held a national consultation with licensed operators on Somalia's roadmap for joining the East African Community's One Network Area, a phased alignment of national laws and tariffs with regional standards; adoption is described as still to be completed.

Somalia presented its plan for adopting artificial intelligence at a meeting of the East African Science and Technology Commission (EASTECO), where its delegation also worked with the East Africa Kiswahili Commission.

An EAC ICT and performance management professional told an EALA oversight meeting that Somalia had yet to implement the 2014 One Network Area roaming framework, though it had formally committed to aligning its domestic regulations with it.
